text.p: Line-up on Friday for the last 16 of the men's EuroLeague basketball competition following the final round of group matches: Stefanel Milan (Italy) v Kinder Bologna (Italy) Alba Berlin (Germany) v Barcelona (Spain) Partizan Belgrade (Yugoslavia) v Olympiakos (Greece) Efes Pilsen (Turkey) v Maccabi Tel Aviv (Israel) Teamsystem Bologna (Italy) v Sevilla (Spain) Cibona Zagreb (Croatia) v Ljubljana (Slovenia) Villeurbanne (France) v Estudiantes Madrid (Spain) Panathinaikos (Greece) v Limoges (France)
To be played on a knock-out basis with games to be played over two legs on March 6 and 11 with third games (if necessary) on March 13.
